APPROVAL OF THE AMENDMENT OF PLANNING REGULATION ANDGUIDELINES FOR GALLE FORT ARCHAEOLOGICAL CONSERVATION ZONEOF GREATER GALLE DEVELOPMENT PLAN 2021 - 2031
I, Prasanna Ranathunga, Minister of Urban Development and Housing do hereby approve the amendments to the Chapter 9.2
of the Planning Regulations and Guidelines for the Galle Fort Archaeological Conservation of Greater Galle Development
Plan 2021 - 2031 under the powers vested in me by Section 8 (H) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978
as amended by the Urban Development Authority (Amendment) Act No. 4 of 1982 after consideration of the recommendation
made by the Board of Management of Urban Development Authority dated 29th May, 2024.
Pඋൺඌൺඇඇൺ Rൺඇൺඍඁඎඇ඀ൺ (M.P.), Minister of Urban Development and Housing.

NOTICE OF APPROVAL OF THE AMENDMENT OF PLANNING REGULATION ANDGUIDELINES FOR GALLE FORT ARCHAEOLOGICAL CONSERVATION ZONEOF GREATER GALLE DEVELOPMENT PLAN 2021 - 2031

NOTICE is hereby given to the General Public of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka under Section 8 (G) of the Urban Development Authority Law No. 41 of 1978 as amended by the Act, No. 04 of 1982 that I, Prasanna Ranathunga, the Minister in charge of the subject of Urban Development and Housing by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 8 (F) of the said Act, No. 4 of 1982 have approved the Amendments to the Chapter 9.2 of the Planning Regulation and Guidelines for Galle Fort Archaeological Conservation Zone of Greater Galle Development Plan 2021 - 2031 made under Section 8(H) of the said Act on the 13th day of June, 2024.
Pඋൺඌൺඇඇൺ Rൺඇൺඍඁඎඇ඀ൺ (M.P.), Minister of Urban Development and Housing.
Ministry of Urban Development and Housing,12th Floor,“Sethsiripaya” Stage II,Battaramulla.
APPROVAL OF THE AMENDMENT OF PLANNING REGULATION ANDGUIDELINES FOR GALLE FORT ARCHAEOLOGICAL CONSERVATION ZONEOF GREATER GALLE DEVELOPMENT PLAN 2021 - 2031

PUBLIC are hereby informed that the Amendments to the Chapter 9.2 of Greater Galle Development Plan 2021 - 2031 Galle Fort Archaeological Conservation Zone, prepared under Section 8 (A) of the Urban Development Authority Law, No. 41 of 1978 as amended by the Act, No. 04 of 1982, has been approved on 13th June, 2024, by Hon. Prasanna Ranathunga, Minister of Urban Development and Housing, by virtue of powers vested on him under Section 8 (F) of the said Act.
